blocks.translation:
• Warning: To customers who purchased this product — please read carefully.
• The target age for this product is 15 years and older. Do not give it to children under the target age under any circumstances.
• This product contains small parts and batteries; take care that small children do not accidentally swallow them. There is a risk of choking and similar hazards.
• There are pointed and sharp parts; take care when handling and storing. There is a risk of unexpected injury.
• Do not use near the ears. If used incorrectly, there is a risk of hearing damage.
• This product contains electronic components. If you use a pacemaker, be careful not to bring this product close to your body.
• Do not stare continuously at the flashing light of the LED. It may cause you to feel unwell.
• If batteries are used incorrectly there is a risk of heating, explosion, or leakage. Please observe the following cautions.
• Do not use secondary (rechargeable) batteries under any circumstances.
• Do not mix old and new batteries or different types of batteries.
• Insert the + and − (plus and minus) polarity correctly.

blocks.translation:
• This product is precision-made. Applying excessive force or dropping it may cause damage.

• This product has painted parts, so when storing it do not let it come into contact with other items (plastic products, furniture, sofas). Color transfer may occur.

• Really?

blocks.translation:
• My father is an executive of Tojitendo,

• He could trust his parents straightforwardly,
• and he had such a warm place like this....
• Out of my selfish jealousy, I tried to defeat Kaito.

• Because you're kind, when things were painful

• But you don't have to force yourself anymore.
• Just toss it all away and move on to the next thing.
• A warm place like that,
• you can make one anywhere else as much as you want.
• ...Yes!
• Of course, our place is always more than welcome! But you know.

• I told Yatsude everything.
